summary: Iteration 9 — Stripe billing, outbound webhooks, and PWA manifest fully verified. 12/13 pytest tests pass + all 8 frontend flows pass. Stripe checkout session creation returns a valid https://checkout.stripe.com URL and UI-click redirects the browser there. Webhook subscription CRUD, test-delivery (to https://httpbin.org/post status_code=200 success=true), toggle enabled, delete, and the fire-and-forget integration (POST /api/workers -> 'worker.added' delivery recorded within 1-2s) all work. Sidebar 'Webhooks' link (data-testid=nav-app-webhooks) appears under ECOSYSTEM. Settings → Billing tab renders BillingPanel with tier/status/Change-plan. Dashboard ?billing=cancelled URL param shows the cancel toast. /manifest.json returns 200 with all required PWA fields + start_url=/worker. The only failure: GET /api/billing/status/<session_id> returns 500 for fresh never-completed test sessions because the backend doesn't catch the `CheckoutError` raised by emergentintegrations when Stripe returns 404 resource_missing. This breaks the ?billing=success polling UX.

critical.issue: Raises unhandled CheckoutError -> 500 when Stripe's session lookup fails (e.g., resource_missing 404 from Stripe for fresh never-completed test sessions). The Dashboard.jsx polling after ?billing=success will crash with repeated 500s. Wrap `await stripe_checkout.get_checkout_status(session_id)` in try/except and on CheckoutError either (a) return the cached txn with current payment_status unchanged, or (b) map to 502/404 with a JSON error body the frontend can handle.

action_items: Wrap GET /api/billing/status/{session_id} Stripe call in try/except CheckoutError. For resource_missing / transient Stripe errors, return the cached txn with its existing payment_status (or return 202 with {pending:true}). This prevents the Dashboard billing-success poll from hitting 500.
Optional: since polling runs for ~30s on successful checkout (per Dashboard.jsx), add short-circuit if txn.status==='open' after N retries without a webhook event.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py billing_status() has no try/except around stripe_checkout.get_checkout_status(); any Stripe error bubbles as 500 (confirmed in logs: emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.CheckoutError: No such checkout.session).

server.py is now 2146 lines — past the 700-line maintenance threshold. Consider splitting billing (L1809-1973), webhooks (L1976-2120), worker/mobile, safety, and auth into separate routers under /app/backend/routes/ for readability.
WEBHOOK_EVENTS is a module-level `set` used for ordering — list_webhook_events sorts on every call which is fine but freeze as a tuple + cached sorted list once at import.

trigger_webhook_event() is awaited inline in create_worker/update_incident/... which means HTTP request latency to user is bounded by external target_url reachability (10s timeout). For httpbin it's fine but a slow Zapier endpoint will slow down the core CRUD. Consider asyncio.create_task(_deliver_webhook(...)) (true fire-and-forget) or a background worker queue.
seed_data_creation: Test created + deleted: 1 Stripe checkout session (cs_test_...), 2 webhook subscriptions (pytest + UI), ~5 webhook_deliveries docs, 1 TEST_Iter9 worker (deleted in test).

rca_of_the_issue: GET /api/billing/status/{sid} 500 RCA: emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.get_checkout_status() calls stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve() which raises stripe._error.InvalidRequestError('No such checkout.session') -> wrapped as CheckoutError. server.py:1893 does not catch this. Reproduction: (1) POST /api/billing/checkout with {tier_slug:'small_business_monthly',origin_url:<any>} (2) immediately GET /api/billing/status/<returned session_id> — returns 500. Mitigation: wrap line 1893 in try/except CheckoutError and either return existing cached txn from line 1882 unchanged, or respond 202 {pending:true} so the frontend poll loop can retry without showing an error toast.
